register 1222: L-shaped complex of 1641-1642 with natural stone bands; two trapezium gables split by a pediment with oeils-de-boeuf and date stones on the front, one gable on Prins Hendrikkade and two on Peperstraat (text only)
OSM way w268782366 West-Indisch Pakhuis, ref:bag 0363100012170633

notes: Scope is the BAG pand 0363100012170633 only (the little commies building at the corner and the neighbours stay). The north-west front and the north-east side are measured from the straight-on and corner photographs; the twelve axes, shutter pattern and gable positions were read off Pakhuiswic.jpg. The south-west and south-east courtyard faces have only close-ups, so their window rhythm is inferred. Roofs, dormers and chimneys come from 3DBAG; the NE eaves pediment and the east-end hoist beam are placed by eye. ANNO / 1642 / 1641 date stones and the WIC monogram are left as blank plaques. The Peperstraat gable count in the register (two) matches the two gables on the north-west front.
